title: Managing and Controlling Pain
author: GGWXGhP7McKTXiTQc
chapter_outcomes: Describe functions of pain; types of pain: acute and chronic pain; focus on phantom limb pain and mirror treatment to include a case study, e.g. MacLachlan et al. (2004)
Describe and evaluate theories of pain; specificity theory, gate control theory
Describe and evaluate subjective measures including clinical interview
Describe and evaluate psychometric measures and visual rating scales; McGill pain questionnaire, visual analogue scale
Describe and evaluate comparing pain assessments by doctors, parents and children (Key Study: Brudvik et al., 2016)
Describe and evaluate behavioural/observational measures; UAB pain behaviour scale
Describe and evaluate biological treatment; biochemical
Describe and evaluate psychological treatments; cognitive strategies (attention diversion, non-pain imagery and cognitive redefinition)
Describe and evaluate alternative treatments; acupuncture, and stimulation therapy/TENS
